admission_gates.accepted_value_identity_and_semantics: 100 percent verified owned response hash, unique table/row/current column, release date, observation date and units
admission_gates.before_models: Root explicit tierB/C assumption acceptance plus independent parser/version audit; freeze candidate source/config and new attempt budget before any fitness
admission_gates.rationale: Prespecified operational completeness conditions, not confidence/significance thresholds; no BTC outcomes used. All97 scoring dates would remain fixed with any explicitly registered neutral/missing handling.

benchmark: All frozen scoring modules,17-family atlas,97 query dates,readout and12/24/48month outcomes unchanged; prior16indicator attempts and outer history exposed. No extra slot in completed campaigns.

calendar.caveat: Current retrospective calendar, not an authenticated original census
calendar.discovery: Captured release index calls getJSON(releaseDates.json) and constructs /releases/h41/YYYYMMDD

extraction: Match consolidated-statement title, exact Total assets row, current Wednesday header/date and Millions of dollars; reject wrong table/unit/date, duplicate candidates and ambiguity. Never take eliminations, prior-year changes, district sums or weekly averages.

monthly_queries.warmup: Five years before the first benchmark date; does not add forecast scoring dates

policy.fetch: Same HTTPS Board host only; bounded source-listed URLs; stop on401/403/429 or challenge; no denied-access retries/host or agent changes; no FREDrequests
policy.robots_meaning: No explicit robots rules at checked endpoint, not blanket permission
policy.rule: Board information public-domain default unless otherwise indicated; source attribution required by project; excludes logos and non-Board material

release_selection: Latest source-listed release with printed date <= query minus two calendar days (inclusive date threshold, not a claim the release was known at00UTC on that earlier date). Query is00UTC; conservative whole-date lag covers late US publication. Actual holidays come from calendar.
scope: A reconstructed monthly published-level series for source audit and possible later registered research; not authenticated point-in-time data. No model or fitness authorized by this contract.
source: Federal Reserve Board H.4.1 consolidated total assets, current Wednesday level, USD millions

version_tiers.A: Explicit original or independently established target-value original lineage; none presumed
version_tiers.B: Dated current archive edition, documented correction confined to other fields. Target continuity remains a reconstruction assumption.
version_tiers.C: Dated current archive edition, no identified target correction after scoped announcement review. Absence of notice is not proof of no revision.
version_tiers.D: Target affected or correction scope/value unresolved; recover original lineage or exclude. Never backdate a corrected value.
